item.body:
### Summary

As a logged-in member, I want a left swipe on a topic in **Favoris** to remove it from my favourites. Today it shows « Action impossible — Session non confirmée : rien n'a été envoyé. Reconnectez-vous puis réessayez. », although the session works: the list itself loads. (Operator feedback, 2026-11-17 21:38 Paris, device screenshot.)

### What the code says (dev-swift)

- The message comes from `App/SwiftHFR/Navigation/TopicFlagActions.swift:85-86`, case `TopicFlagError.sessionNotConfirmed(SessionHealth)`.
- It is thrown by `TopicFlagFlow.confirm` (`Packages/HFRKit/Sources/HFRClient/Flags/TopicFlagFlow.swift:164-174`). Every flag write first runs the LOT-044 session check (`SessionRefreshFlow.refresh`, `SessionRefreshFlow.swift:41`), and refuses unless the health is `.valid`. This is the #314 guard: a cookie-less `addflag`/`delflag` gets success bytes, so the answer of the write alone proves nothing.
- `SessionHealth` (`HFRClient/Session/SessionHealth.swift`) is `.valid`, `.expired(SessionExpiry)` or `.unconfirmed(UnconfirmedSession)`. The UI maps **both** non-valid cases to « Reconnectez-vous ». For `.unconfirmed`, that advice is wrong: HFR's answer proved neither state.
- So the refresh check returned non-valid on a session that reads fine. Which case, and why, is **not known**. Do not guess (AGENTS.md §3.1). Candidates to check, without assuming any:
  - the profile-page probe answer changed or was redirected;
  - the probe jar (LOT-044 compare-and-set);
  - a timeout or an idle limit. #1009 (10 s idle, merged 2026-11-17 ~20:30 UTC) is probably not in the build used, so check the build;
  - the session store of the account.

### Scope

1. **Reproduce on the Mac with the test account `user2`**, never the real account. Swipe-remove a favourite.
   - Record which `SessionHealth` case and which `SessionExpiry` / `UnconfirmedSession` reason came back.
   - Record the probe request's status and redirect chain, anonymised, with no cookies and no tokens. Capture the probe page if it differs from the LOT-044 fixtures.
   - Note the build's commit.
2. **Fix the cause** once known, with a test on the captured answer.
3. **Messages:**
   - `.expired` keeps « Reconnectez-vous ».
   - `.unconfirmed` says the check could not confirm the session and nothing was sent, and offers « Réessayer » rather than a re-login.
   - Keep « rien n'a été envoyé » in both.
4. Apply the same to every write behind `confirm`: add or remove a favourite, mark unread, delete an MP, polls (`PollMessages.swift:22`).

### Acceptance criteria

- On the Mac, the swipe removal works on `user2`: the topic leaves Favoris and the `delflag` confirmation sentence is checked (LOT-051).
- A test reproduces the captured non-valid answer and fails before the fix.
- Tests cover the message mapping: `.expired` versus `.unconfirmed`.
- This is a state-changing flow, so cloud/orch merges it after a Fable review if the author is Opus (AGENTS.md §8).

### Device check (for the #893 general review)

On the operator's account: a swipe-left removal from Favoris succeeds.

comments.body:
/claim mac/M1

Night plan item a. Plan: reproduce the session check of `TopicFlagFlow.confirm` with **user2 only** against the live forum (the check is a read; no flag write is sent), log the `SessionHealth` case and reason, the probe's status and redirect chain, anonymised (no cookie, no token), on `dev-swift` at its current head; then fix the cause and the `.unconfirmed` message in a draft PR, Fable review; cloud/orch merges.

---
_Generated by [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code)_

**mac/M1: findings and a first PR (#1078, draft, Fable review running; cloud/orch merges).**

**Reproduction on the Mac (2026-11-17, `dev-swift` 1df2121a, user2 only, read-only):**
- A fresh user2 session run through `SessionRefreshFlow.refresh`, which is what `TopicFlagFlow.confirm` calls, comes back **`valid`**.
- The probe by hand: **200, served at exactly the requested URL**, no redirect and no `Location`, `Set-Cookie` present, not a `.hop`, the profile page parses, and the token is present.
- So HFR's page and the engine's rules hold. The non-valid answer comes from the **app-side state of the operator's account session**.

**What makes the screenshot ambiguous:** all five non-valid results (2 `expired`, 3 `unconfirmed`) showed the same « Reconnectez-vous » text, so the screenshot cannot say which check failed.

**Leads, not proven:**
1. The account came from the legacy import, which keeps each cookie's own domain (`KeychainLegacyAccountSource.swift:89`). The jar may then hold two `md_user`, and `userKey` takes the first non-empty one (`.unconfirmed(.identityNotConfirmed)`).
2. An identity or login-generation change while the check ran (`.sessionChanged`).
3. A real `.expired`.

Ruled out: a stale session copy, since the lists and the flag writer share one `HFRSession` (`AppEnvironment.swift:44, 58`).

**#1078:**
- each case gets its own text, and only `.expired` says « Reconnectez-vous »;
- « Réessayer » in the list's alert when nothing left and a retry may work;
- the case is logged (`os.Logger`, subsystem `SwiftHFR`, category `session`, no secret).

`Refs #1056`: the cause stays open until the operator's next attempt names the case.

**Operator, on your next build:** swipe-remove a favourite. If it fails, post the alert's text here (or Console.app, category `session`): it says which of the three leads it is.
